caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling an antique mechanical device, composed primarily of a vertically oriented handle with rounded, bulbous segments, colored in shades of brown and metallic tones. The handle is attached to an upper segment that features vertical grooves, appearing to be made of metal and shaded with blues, browns, and purples. This segment is connected to a lower, platform-like base, also grooved and colored in similar hues of blue, brown, and dark red. The base has three thin, tapered legs and an ornate extension on one end, curling in a decorative manner and incorporating blue and brown coloration. The background is plain and beige, with no other objects or features present. The composition centers the device in the image, with the handle to the left and the ornate extension to the right.
title: Fluting Iron
